input.command:
python3 -c '
# Triangulate plant 1 from obs 97 and 98:
import cv2, numpy as np

# Poses:
# obs 97: pose (-0.2688, 5.0972), theta = 300 deg
# obs 98: move 0.5 along 300 deg ->
#   X = -0.2688 - 0.4330 = -0.7018
#   Y = 5.0972 + 0.2500 = 5.3472

img97 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0097.png")
img98 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0098.png")

mask97 = (img97[:,:,2] > 140) & (img97[:,:,1] < 100) & (img97[:,:,0] < 60)
mask98 = (img98[:,:,2] > 140) & (img98[:,:,1] < 100) & (img98[:,:,0] < 60)

ys97, xs97 = np.where(mask97)
ys98, xs98 = np.where(mask98)

w97 = xs97.max() - xs97.min() + 1
w98 = xs98.max() - xs98.min() + 1

print(f"Pot 1 obs 97: x=[{xs97.min()}, {xs97.max()}], width={w97}, bottom_y={ys97.max()}, center_x={xs97.mean():.1f}")
print(f"Pot 1 obs 98: x=[{xs98.min()}, {xs98.max()}], width={w98}, bottom_y={ys98.max()}, center_x={xs98.mean():.1f}")

d98 = 0.5 / (float(w98) / float(w97) - 1.0)
print(f"Parallax depth d97 = {d98 + 0.5:.4f} m, d98 = {d98:.4f} m")

# Position from obs 98:
theta_rad = np.deg2rad(300.0)
Xc98 = (xs98.mean() - 255.5) / 256.0 * d98
X_pot = -0.7018 + d98 * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc98 * np.cos(theta_rad)
Y_pot = 5.3472 + d98 * np.cos(theta_rad) - Xc98 * np.sin(theta_rad)
print(f"Plant 1 position: X = {X_pot:.4f}, Y = {Y_pot:.4f}")
'
